notes: Landscape, straight-on, a wall of dark wooden shelving in a Japanese bookshop (a price note in Japanese on the shelf edge) in even daylight, no glare; 6000x4000, twelve bays of tightly packed paperbacks, several hundred books. Japanese throughout (one English title, Travelers). Only three bays were read at full size: the cat-book bay (top centre), the children's-classics bay (top right) and the Shibusawa/art bay (middle centre); the remaining nine bays, including the bottom two rows and the whole left column, are left unlabelled because the type is too small to read without many more crops, not because it is illegible. Series: the two boxed sets of トガリ山のぼうけん are labelled by the series title with the eight volume names printed on the boxes in partial (the volumes themselves are inside the boxes); 書物の王国 volumes are labelled series plus volume name; multi-volume novels (レ・ミゼラブル 下, 三銃士 上・下, ハックルベリー・フィン 上) are labelled once by title; the Iwanami 世界児童文学集 24 is labelled by its volume title 山賊のむすめローニャ. Repeats (きょうの猫村さん, 猫の客, イワン、はじめての旅, 遠くからの声) labelled once. Partial: the Inagaki Taruho collected works (volume number only), the Doré and Dick Bruna art books far right (titles partly hidden), 穂高 THE WORLD (large picture book lying at bottom right, title partly hidden by the shelf). Left out within the read bays: the 夜想 magazines (not books), and a dozen spines whose titles I could not read with confidence (the Ikeda Akiko Dayan volumes beyond the four named, 猫がゆく, うさぎのマシュマロ, 暗黒のメルヘン, the Hatoyama Ikuko neighbours, the 望月通陽 pair). Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 97), verified by an agent.
